title: Grove Bay Harbour Boat Racks
address:
2640 S Bayshore Dr
Miami, Florida 33133
United States
description: Grove Bay Harbour's boat racks are one piece of a multi-phase, 9.5-acre waterfront redevelopment in Coconut Grove, built on the site of the former Grove Key Marina along the historic Dinner Key/Bayshore footprint. The storage structure combines hangar storage and dry-stack racks, designed to hold more than 400 vessels.
